discourse.excerpt: What is good for you is akin to truth; truth is hard: but beneficial. It is unpleasant advice to tell a man to stick to truth at all costs; but, truth alone pays dividends that satisfy.
discourse.theme: God grants true prosperity to those who hold to truth — truth is hard, but it alone pays dividends that satisfy.
discourse.title: Ishwara grants Aishwaryam

reflection: Swami says what is good for us is akin to truth — hard, but beneficial — and truth alone pays dividends that satisfy. Today, in one conversation, choose the honest word over the pleasing one. (Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 4, 13 Dec 1964)
seva_nudge: Give someone honest, kindly meant advice today — the truth they need to hear, not just the words they want to hear.

video.title: “When Grace is Overflowing, Hold it!” | Dr. Phil Gosselin on Sathya Sai
